name: kompass
description: Explore where to live in Norway, learn about a municipality, and compare places using recorded public data.

interface.shortDescription: Find where to live in Norway
interface.longDescription:
Explore where to live in Norway: ask what living in Lillehammer is like, whether a municipality fits your stated priorities, compare Bærum with Asker, or start researching what growing up in a municipality could be like for children. Kompass provides recorded municipality facts to inform these questions; it does not provide a complete assessment of quality of life or childhood conditions. For personal fit, clarify what matters to you rather than declaring a place right for you. For children, distinguish recorded schools from evidence about school quality, safety, wellbeing, childcare capacity or neighbourhood conditions, which this plugin does not establish.

Find Norwegian municipalities using your stated priorities: county, population, recorded housing prices, straight-line distance from Oslo, Montessori or Steiner schools, and recorded local support schemes. Open municipality details and build a shortlist with links to Kompass. Display individual FINN home-listing links from the conversation in a card, with a handoff to review and save on the Kompass website. Website sign-in and existing account permissions apply; nothing is saved by the plugin.

For people exploring where to live in Norway. No Kompass login is required. This plugin reads public municipality records and cannot save to an account or manage subscriptions.

Data limitations: on 3 October 2026, all 264 available housing prices matched SSB table 06035, 2024 detached-house figures. These are historical municipal averages, not current listings or home valuations. Other source observation dates are not exposed by the current API. Distance is straight-line, not driving time. A recorded school does not establish available places. Recorded schemes do not confirm personal eligibility; check the original source. Missing data means unknown.
defaultPrompt: Hvordan er det å bo i Lillehammer, og passer kommunen for det jeg ser etter?
Sammenlign Bærum med Asker som steder å bo.
Hvordan er det å vokse opp for barn i Lillehammer? Vis hva dere har data om og hva jeg bør undersøke videre.

positive.description: Combined school and historical price filters
positive.prompt: Finn kommuner med Montessoriskole og registrert boligpris under 40 000 kr/m². Vis tre kommuner og databegrensninger.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply both filters; display bounded matching results and historical-price / school-capacity limitations. Do not claim current listings.

positive.prompt: Vis tre kommuner i Innlandet med mellom 2 000 og 10 000 innbyggere.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply county and inclusive population bounds. Explain missing data and avoid a best-place ranking.

positive.description: FINN listing card and website handoff
positive.prompt: Vis disse lenkene samlet i Kompass: Stølen 20 https://www.finn.no/realestate/homes/ad.html?finnkode=474110276 og Vestre Prestbøvegen 4A https://www.finn.no/realestate/homes/ad.html?finnkode=471874912. Ikke lagre noe ennå.
positive.expected_behavior: Render the listing card with a general Kompass link and save-on-website button. Canonicalize the URLs. Explain that nothing is saved and existing account access plus website confirmation are required. Do not promote upgrades or assert current listing availability.

positive.prompt: Vis registrerte vilkår og originalkilder for ordningene i Austrheim. Ikke anta at jeg er kvalifisert.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Austrheim to its returned municipality number and retrieve recorded conditions and available source URLs. State unknown last-verification date.

positive.prompt: Lag en kortliste i denne rekkefølgen: Alvdal, Dovre, Eidskog. Vis Kompass-lenker. Ikke lagre den på en konto.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve municipality numbers; preserve requested order; show missing prices as unknown and map links; explicitly do not claim account persistence.

negative.prompt: Finn kommuner som garantert er maks én time fra Oslo med bil.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not translate straight-line kilometres to driving minutes. Explain that driving-time filtering is unavailable and suggest verifying routes.

negative.description: Do not turn total budget into unit price
negative.prompt: Jeg har fire millioner kroner til en bolig. Finn boliger jeg kan kjøpe med Kompass.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Kompass does not provide live home listings or prove affordability. Clarify criteria rather than treating 4 million as NOK per square metre.

negative.prompt: Oppgrader abonnementet mitt og lagre kortlisten på kontoen min.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim an upgrade or save occurred and do not promote a paid digital subscription. Explain that the connector only reads public municipality records.

publication.release_notes: Adds a proactive FINN-to-Kompass invitation alongside municipality search and shortlist results. Users can paste individual FINN home listing URLs to prepare a website save handoff. Existing Premium account and website confirmation required to save; neutral general-app link available to everyone. No automatic account writes or subscription promotion. Adds discovery descriptions for living in a named municipality, comparing municipalities, and researching childhood conditions, with explicit evidence limits.
